description: Mappings of the test design of PERM-HIERARCHY with their class and explanation, worked out by hand from the definitions of PRD 20.2: a permutation is square, has only plain sources and reads every input exactly once; the explanation of anything else is the first of: widths differ, an input read more than once (lowest input first), an output that is inverted, a constant or a don't-care (lowest output first).

cases.explanation: each of the 8 input bits is read exactly once
each of the 1 input bits is read exactly once
